verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਚੁ ਸੁਰੰਗ ਹੈ ਮੂਲ ਮਜੀਠ ਨ ਟਲੈ ਟਲੰਦਾ।
verses.translit_en: gurmukh sach sura(n)g hai mool majeeTh na Talai Tala(n)dhaa|

en.bdb: Truth in the form of gurmukhs is such a beautiful madder colour which never fades.

verses.gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਕੂੜੁ ਕੁਰੰਗ ਹੈ ਫੁਲ ਕੁਸੁੰਭੈ ਥਿਰ ਨ ਰਹੰਦਾ।
verses.translit_en: manmukh kooR kura(n)g hai ful kusu(n)bhai thir na raha(n)dhaa|

en.bdb: The colour of mind oriented, manmukh, is like the colour of safflower which soon fades away.

verses.gurmukhi: ਥੋਮ ਕਥੂਰੀ ਵਾਸੁ ਲੈ ਨਕੁ ਮਰੋੜੈ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਵੰਦਾ।
verses.translit_en: thom kathooree vaas lai nak maroRai man bhaava(n)dhaa|

en.bdb: The falsehood, as against truth, is like garlic contrasted to musk. At the smell of the former the nose is turned away whereas the latter's fragrance is pleasing to mind.

verses.gurmukhi: ਕੂੜੁ ਸਚੁ ਅਕ ਅੰਬ ਫਲ ਕਉੜਾ ਮਿਠਾ ਸਾਉ ਲਹੰਦਾ।
verses.translit_en: kooR sach ak a(n)b fal kauRaa miThaa saau laha(n)dhaa|

en.bdb: Falsehood and truth are like akk, the wild plant of sandy region and mango tree which bear bitter and sweet fruits respectively.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਾਹ ਚੋਰ ਸਚ ਕੂੜੁ ਹੈ ਸਾਹੁ ਸਵੈ ਚੋਰੁ ਫਿਰੈ ਭਵੰਦਾ।
verses.translit_en: saeh chor sach kooR hai saahu savai chor firai bhava(n)dhaa|

en.bdb: Truth and falsehood are like the bankar and the thief; the banker sleeps comfortably whereas the thief roams about hither and thither.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਾਹ ਫੜੈ ਉਠਿ ਚੋਰ ਨੋ ਤਿਸ ਨੁਕਸਾਨ ਦੀਬਾਣ ਕਰੰਦਾ।
verses.translit_en: saeh faRai uTh chor no tis nukasaan dheebaan kara(n)dhaa|

en.bdb: The banker catches hold of the thief and gets him further punished in the courts.
The truth ultimately puts shackles around the falsehood.
